import os,re,json,numpy as np
from collections import defaultdict
t=open(os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']+'/../../sessions/01a1b5be-3677-71cf-81da-62f81d59ac5e.jsonl')).read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]) ,int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
def solve(g):
    g=np.array(g); out=g.copy(); h,w=g.shape
    ys,xs=np.where(g==1)
    pts=list(zip(ys.tolist(),xs.tolist()))
    cc=defaultdict(list); rr=defaultdict(list)
    for y,x in pts: cc[x].append(y); rr[y].append(x)
    vl={c for c,v in cc.items() if len(v)>=2}
    hl={r for r,v in rr.items() if len(v)>=2}
    lab,n=ndimage.label(g==2)
    for l in range(1,n+1):
        yy,xx=np.where(lab==l)
        r0,r1=int(yy.min()),int(yy.max()); c0,c1=int(xx.min()),int(xx.max())
        # line cuts square iff it splits it into TWO pieces: strict interior crossing
        hvv = any(c0<x<c1 for x in vl)
        hhh = any(r0<y<r1 for y in hl)
        if hvv or hhh: out[yy,xx]=1
    return out
ok = np.array_equal(solve(G['Demo pair 1 input']),O)
print('demo match:', ok)
res=solve(G['Test input']).tolist()
print(json.dumps(res))
